questions.q: The OSHA 'Occupational Exposure to Hazardous Chemicals in Laboratories' standard (29 CFR 1910.1450) requires every lab to develop a written:
questions.explain: OSHA requires laboratories to have a written Chemical Hygiene Plan (CHP) which sets forth procedures, equipment, PPE, and work practices that are capable of protecting employees from the health hazards presented by hazardous chemicals.
